scope: All detected tables and source-image occurrences, plus heuristic dense-formula candidates and supplied plans.
warning: Detection is not a completeness proof or a requirement to explain a formula. Check direct reading for ordinary-length formulas; reserve meaning-focused explanations for longer formulas. A bound reviewed flag is not evidence of visual, playback, listening, or independent comprehension QA.

table: measured cell highlights and readable layout
image: measured region highlighting and readable magnifier
denseFormula: choose direct reading for ordinary formulas; explanation only for longer formulas
exact signs indices conditions and order
for longer formulas: mathematical meaning and nontrivial transitions
